verdicts.matching_evidence: Definition of the overdensity δ in Eq. (1) is inconsistent with the values used throughout the paper. Eq. (1) reads δ = (n − n̄)/(2 n̄), i.e. a factor 2 in the denominator. However, on p. 13 the text states 'there is an overdensity with three massive QGs ... with 3.8 times more galaxies than the average (δ ~ 2.8)'. This mapping only holds for the standard definition δ = (n − n̄)/n̄ = n/n̄ − 1, which gives δ = 2.8 from n/n̄ = 3.8; Eq. (1) would give (3.8−1)/2 = 1.4.
